column1: # THE DEATH OF SIXTA LENGUAS - Montevideo, 2nd section, act No. 45, 17 January 1884.
# Juez de Paz and Oficial del Estado Civil: Cipriano Martinez.
# Index ark 1:1:XS6L-8R7Z; image ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2W-N36Y-D. IMAGE READ 14 September 2026, level 12.
# Opened because the whole "Justiniana and Sixta were sisters" finding rested on the INDEX of this
# record. The image confirms it - and gives two generations the index never mentioned.

column2: 17 January 1884, at one in the morning, calle de Piedras No. 202
Dona SIXTA LENGUAS, Oriental, edad 47 anos, casada
column3: Born about 1837 - some fifteen years younger than her sister Justiniana, who was 79 in 1901.

column2: *** "hija de D. PEDRO LENGUAS y de Dona CARMEN GONZALEZ, finados" ***
column3: *** THE SISTERS FINDING IS NOW ON AN IMAGE. *** The 1846 baptisms give Justiniana's parents as the same couple - one of them calling him "el General D. Pedro Lenguas". Both women are daughters of Pedro Lenguas and Carmen Gonzalez.

column2: *** "sus abuelos paternos D. ANTONIO LENGUAS y Dona JUANA GRANDAL" ***
column3: *** A GENERATION THIS ARCHIVE HAD NEVER REACHED. *** Pedro Lenguas's own parents. An Antonio Lenguas, born 1807 at Buenos Aires and buried 30 July 1841 at Las Piedras, Canelones, with a wife JUANA GRANDAL, is already in the indexed Uruguayan records - almost certainly this man.

column2: *** "maternos D. PASCUAL GONZALEZ y Dona JOSEFA GRANDAL, finados" ***
column3: Carmen Gonzalez's parents. *** NOTE THAT BOTH GRANDMOTHERS ARE GRANDAL *** - Juana Grandal and Josefa Grandal. Pedro Lenguas and Carmen Gonzalez were very probably cousins. Recorded as an observation; no record read here links the two women directly.

column2: *** "Su esposo D. CANDIDO JUANICO, Oriental, edad 72 anos, viudo, ABOGADO" ***
column3: Born about 1812, and a LAWYER - which is why this archive has always written him "Dr. Don Candido Juanico". He was 72 and had just been widowed a second time. His first wife Juliana Joaquina Gonzalez bore Julia in 1842.

column2: D. Juan Caceres Vico, 30, of calle Convencion; D. Vicente Urta, 47, comerciante, of calle Mesina 149
